'''Hagk Baht''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who owned and operated the ''[[Singing Savrip]]'' during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Baht attempted to smuggle blasters to agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] aboard his ship, ''[[Singing Savrip]]''. In the process, he narrowly avoided an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs blockade. An incredibly violent sandstorm at the rendezvous point, however, caused Baht to crash outside of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the crash, but the fifty [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] he was transporting remained intact.
